description: Reviewed pins for the llama.cpp Windows CPU x64 archives bundled by the Standard Portable and Corporate Lite builders. A release tag without an entry here is refused unless -AllowUnpinnedLlamaCpuRuntime is passed explicitly. To add a pin: download the archive, compute SHA-256, compare with the digest on the upstream release page (gh api repos/ggml-org/llama.cpp/releases/tags/<tag>), then add an entry in a reviewed commit.
